name: Web lanes read: principal read authority with route-selected scope
summary: The web Lanes route authenticates each member with CAP_READ, then EndpointBackend.lanes_read sends that principal's read descriptor to the canonical work lanes action with live authority required. BLOCK_CAPABILITIES binds exactly work/lanes to read; unrelated work forms remain unbound. The route alone chooses all lanes for an installation owner/coordinator or own lanes otherwise, and lanes_scope can only narrow that choice. In-process and real endpoint backends share the signature. Real HTTP/bd coverage checks owner, coordinator, contributor, read-only agent, non-member and unauthenticated behavior.
